verdict.rationale: Mercury ships AI features, including AI bill reading, AI-powered bookkeeping automations and an MCP server, so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a policy or control that keeps customer data out of AI model training. The ability to revoke MCP/API access is a different control and does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
